item.title: Nintendo Games Return To Charity Speedrunning Event 'RTA In Japan' After Previously Demanding "Prior Permission"
item.description: Nintendo games will return for RTA in Japan Winter 2025; after Nintendo previously demanded they seek "prior permission" for each title.

item.title: Robert Englund Says Freddy Krueger Remains Popular Because The Character "Is An Unrepentant, Politically Incorrect Villain With A Dose Of Personality"
item.description: Robert Englund observes it's the political incorrectness of Freddy Krueger that's helped the character endure for so long.
